text:
Sam: quick heads-up — the README curl example uses a header that breaks copy/paste for new users. it shows:
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'X-API-KEY: $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
but our backend expects `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (and the SDKs use REDWOOD_API_KEY). new users get 401s. saw two questions in onboarding this week. :confused:

Maria: ugh, thanks for spotting — that example lives under docs/quickstart/README.md (the curl snippet). I think it got copy/pasted from an old internal guide. :facepalm: we should standardize on `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY` and mention the env var name exactly.

Kevin: on it. i'll open a quick PR to replace the header and add a one-line note about env var. question: do we want to keep an example showing `-H 'Authorization: Token <token>'` for older customers?

Sam: nope, keep single canonical example to reduce confusion. if we need to show alternate auth styles, put them in an "advanced" section.

Maria: also confirm whether our curl examples in other language quickstarts match — node/python/ruby might have the same copy/paste bug. i can grep.

Docs Bot: found 3 matches for "X-API-KEY" in docs repo: docs/quickstart/README.md, docs/samples/voice/README.md, docs/snippets/curl-auth.md — opening links... :link: (preview links in channel)

Kevin: thanks. i'll patch all three in the PR. PR will include:
- replace header with `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY`
- add a 1-line note: "Set REDWOOD_API_KEY env var to your API token"
- run docs smoke test script `scripts/validate-examples.sh`

Sam: can you also add a test to CI that runs `curl` against a local mock endpoint so we won't regress? even a simple parse check that the example contains `Authorization: Bearer` would catch this.

Kevin: yeah i'll add a tiny lint (shellcheck + grep) in the docs workflow. will push to PR and tag y'all.

Maria: perfect. also quick UX note — add a short sentence explaining where to find tokens in the Console (Settings -> API Keys). saves people from hunting.

Kevin: done in branch. PR #512 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 :sparkles: includes fixes + unit for examples.

Sam: nice. did you update the README for the sample-app repo too? onboarding tickets were coming from that repo.

Kevin: not yet — added it to the PR checklist. will include sample-app/README.md change and a one-line CHANGELOG entry.

Maria: once merged, can we backfill a tiny announcement in #onboarding so CS can point new customers to the fixed docs?

Sam: yes please, cc @customer-success.

Kevin: merged at 2480012800. deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/512 — curl examples show correct header. :shipit:

Docs Bot: automated check passed: `scripts/validate-examples.sh` exit=0, examples found: 7, failures: 0.

Maria: closing loop — added a note to the docs backlog to add an examples linter that verifies auth header format across languages. filing ticket DOCS-78.

Sam: thanks everyone. small drift but easy win — great catch. :tada:
